r13_contract.comparisonModel: The upper ice waterline (UIWL) shall be the envelope of the highest points of the waterlines at which the ship is intended to operate in ice. The line may be a broken line.

test_cases.rationale: One intended operating waterline is exactly reproduced by the UIWL envelope.
UIWL takes the pointwise maximum of two intended ice-operating waterlines.
Broken-line UIWL correctly contains the pointwise envelope at three longitudinal positions.
UIWL lies below an intended operating waterline at one position.
UIWL is above rather than equal to the highest intended point, so it is not the envelope.
The upper ice waterline relationship is missing.
UIWL profile points are attached to the wrong owner.

benchmark_policy: Source/R13-defined behavioral oracle created without inspecting generated SHACL.
